jobs.description:
Staff Economist, Marketplace Economics

Change the way the world travels

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Marketplace Economics is a new team at GetYourGuide, built to answer the questions that determine how our marketplace grows and how it should be designed. How much revenue does the next euro of paid search actually return? Which marketing channels are genuinely incremental, and which are taking credit for demand we already had? What price should a supplier set, what does a change in commission do to supply, demand, and liquidity, and how should our ranking and supplier incentives be structured in the first place?

We are a senior team working directly with leadership across Marketing, Pricing, and Supply, among others, and the decisions we inform are among the largest the company makes. On the causal inference side, we draw on tools like experimental design, natural and quasi-experiments, double machine learning, synthetic controls, and more to inform marketing attribution and incrementality, spend allocation, and price elasticity. Our structural work models demand, supply, and the mechanisms connecting them, so we can reason about equilibrium outcomes and simulate counterfactuals we can't run as experiments. Most of our hardest problems in pricing and market design need both.

Your mission

You'll be a technical lead for pricing and supply and a core contributor to our marketplace measurement work. Reporting to the Director of Marketplace Economics, you will:

  • Own the economics of pricing end to end: estimate travel demand and willingness to pay, build the structural models that turn those estimates into defensible price recommendations for our supply partners, and run the experiments that validate them.

  • Work collaboratively with other economists on paid marketing optimization problems across channels and geographies and funnel stages.

  • Work on the design of the marketplace itself; commission and incentive structures, inventory coverage, supply liquidity.

  • Partner closely with business leads in Marketing, Pricing, and Supply by translating ambiguous commercial questions into reasonable identification strategies that drive meaningful business outcomes.

  • Set the technical bar for empirical rigor at GetYourGuide: raise the quality of experiment design across teams, mentor analysts and data scientists.

Your toolkit

  • PhD in Economics, or a closely related quantitative discipline with a strong applied focus.

  • 5+ years of applied work after your PhD, including 2+ years at a marketplace or platform company.

  • Comfort with structural work: discrete choice and demand estimation, equilibrium and counterfactual simulation, and the industrial organization or market design toolkit for reasoning about mechanisms, incentives, and two-sided platform dynamics.

  • Expertise in causal inference: experimental design, difference-in-differences, synthetic control, regression discontinuity, double/debiased ML, and Bayesian approaches to media measurement.

  • The judgment to choose between these approaches for the problem in front of you, and to say clearly what each one can and cannot support.

  • Strong Python and SQL, and comfort working with production-scale data alongside data engineers and scientists.

  • A track record of your analysis influencing business decisions.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for stakeholder work: excellent written and spoken English, and the judgment to know when a simpler answer is the right one.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Market or mechanism design work in production: matching, ranking, allocation, or incentive systems that real users transacted through.

You set the quality standards that carry every programme from first prototypes through to mass production. You lead the Project Quality Engineers and act as the quality counterpart of Program Management, Engineering and our institutional customers. Your work keeps quality gates rigorous at the right level for each development phase, in line with ISO 9001 / EN 9100.

Leadership & Team Building

Overview

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

  • Component selection and BOM management

  • Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.

  • PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.

  • Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.

  • Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.

  • Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.

  • Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.

  • EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.

  • Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.

  • Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.

  • Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

We're looking for motivated professionals who enjoy variety in their work and are eager to lead audit engagements and deepen their experience with U.S. GAAP, audit standards, tax codes, and business operations.

Manay CPA is a global, full-service accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Atlanta, GA. With over 20 years of experience and a diverse team across 4 continents, we proudly support individuals, entrepreneurs, and businesses of all sizes.

Our services include business formation, accounting, tax, payroll, audit, and HR solutions—delivered with a personalized, relationship-first approach. We partner with clients at every stage of their journey, helping them navigate the complexities of business and finance with confidence.

Recognized as a Top 100 Small Business by the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and a Top 25 Small Business of the Year by the COBB Chamber for four consecutive years, we’re trusted by both local and international clients. Our CEO, Burcu Bree Manay, was also named one of the Top 50 Women in Accounting for her leadership and impact in the field.

At Manay CPA, your growth is our purpose. Join a team where innovation, integrity, and global collaboration drive real success.

👉 Learn more at www.manaycpa.com

  • A collaborative and growth-oriented work environment

jobs.title: Sr Clinical Research Associate (Spain)
jobs.description:
Sr Clinical Research Associate (Spain)

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of clinical trials by independently managing clinical site monitoring and site management activities across Spain and Portugal, from study start-up through close-out. You will act as a primary point of contact for investigative sites in these countries, ensuring compliance with protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations and study requirements while supporting high-quality patient data and study delivery.

This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for supporting site performance, resolving issues, maintaining study documentation and providing guidance and mentorship to junior CRAs. You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, sponsors and other cross-functional teams in a dynamic clinical research environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently conduct and document onsite and remote monitoring activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits across Portugal and Spain.
  • Ensure investigative sites comply with study protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, SOPs and project-specific requirements.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned sites, managing site-related questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations through to resolution.
  • Review clinical trial data, source documentation and study systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, data integrity and compliance.
  • Support site selection, activation and recruitment activities, working with sites to achieve study milestones and patient recruitment targets.
  • Ensure sites are appropriately trained on protocols, study systems, processes and applicable requirements throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Maintain oversight of essential study documentation, including ISF and TMF, ensuring documents are complete, accurate and filed in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with sponsors, project teams, vendors and investigative sites to support study timelines, resolve issues and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Participate in audits and inspections, Investigator Meetings, study meetings and other project activities as required.
  • Provide mentoring and support to CRA I and II colleagues, participate in co-monitoring and CRA assessment activities, and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (Honours) in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is preferred.
  • 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience, with 7–9 years preferred.
  • Strong clinical site monitoring experience across clinical trial activities from site start-up through close-out.
  • Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical research principles and applicable local regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with Phase I–IV clinical trials preferred.
  • Proficiency with clinical trial systems such as EDC, IRT, eTMF, CTMS and Microsoft Office, with experience in systems such as Medidata Rave or Oracle InForm preferred.
  • Strong understanding of site management, including site activation, recruitment, training, issue resolution and maintenance of essential documentation.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with investigative sites, sponsors and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organisational, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, with a high level of attention to detail and a sense of urgency.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate sound judgement and manage competing priorities in a results-driven environment.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting junior CRAs is preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project requirements and geographic location.
  • Valid driver’s licence required.
  • Fluent written and verbal English, Spanish and Portuguese

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. jobs.title: Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Application Security Engineer

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Role Overview

The Staff Application Security Engineer leads application security strategy for Apollo’s Security department and delivers it through hands-on work and technical leadership. This role takes on the hardest AppSec problems across product, platform, and AI-powered features, including problems with no established playbook.

The role shapes the roadmaps of Engineering, Product, and Platform teams so secure patterns become the default, and sets the AppSec standard that helps many teams build securely without relying on any single person.

Key Responsibilities

AppSec strategy, standards, and influence

  • Lead Apollo’s multi-year AppSec strategy and turn it into multi-quarter, cross-team initiatives that move Security department KRs. Report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to Security leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Shape Engineering, Product, Platform, and Data roadmaps so security work is planned in early, and represent AppSec in cross-department decisions.
  • Set the secure design, code review, and risk model standards used across the department and adjacent engineering teams, including expectations for AI-generated and agent-generated code.
  • Mentor senior engineers and security champions, grow the champions program, and help raise the hiring bar, so the AppSec program does not depend on one person’s expertise.

Secure architecture and vulnerability depth

  • Lead security architecture reviews and threat modeling for ambiguous, high-scale, multi-team systems, including AI and agent features, and define the approach where no precedent exists.
  • Design and drive adoption of secure-by-default building blocks, such as shared authorization, safe OAuth and token handling, and SSRF-safe HTTP clients, so whole classes of issues stop appearing.
  • Shape vulnerability management across internal reviews, bug bounty, pentests, and SCA and runtime findings, with a focus on root causes, bug classes, and clear risk-based severity decisions.
  • Stay hands-on for the hardest cases: read code across teams, develop exploits, test bypasses, and lead variant analysis and staged remediation across teams.

Tooling, automation, and AI (AI-native by default)

  • Set the standard for AI-augmented AppSec in the department. Use AI and agents for code review, threat modeling, triage, and remediation, and build automation that teams outside Security adopt, with measured gains in speed, coverage, and signal quality.
  • Define how Apollo secures its AI systems and agent features, including input and output handling, AI-exposed APIs, prompt and response guardrails, tool permissions, and data-exfiltration paths.

What Good Looks Like (drafted from your mission and success sections)

  • Owns AppSec strategy across a multi-year horizon and gets it committed in other teams’ roadmaps.
  • Solves ambiguous, no-playbook problems and defines the approach for others to follow.
  • Makes hard risk calls under ambiguity and aligns technical and non-technical leaders without formal authority.
  • Builds guardrails, standards, and people so AppSec scales beyond any one person.

Required Skills & Experience

  • A track record of leading AppSec strategy that changed how several engineering teams build, with measurable results, typically backed by 10+ years in software engineering or application security.
  • Expert code review, penetration testing, and exploit development skills, with the ability to find design flaws in unfamiliar codebases and land fixes that hold up against bypass attempts.
  • Strong software development skills and the ability to ship production code. Ruby and Ruby on Rails experience is highly valuable, and Python is a plus. Strong Linux and cloud fundamentals, ideally GCP and Kubernetes.
  • Deep experience with secure architecture and authentication and authorization patterns, and with building security building blocks that other teams adopt.
  • Hands-on experience securing AI-powered systems or agent features, and a clear point of view on how AI changes application security.
  • The judgment to make hard risk calls under ambiguity, and the influence to align technical and non-technical leaders without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading security for AI-native products, internal agents, or AI-assisted engineering workflows at scale.
  • Experience building or scaling a security champions or developer enablement program.
  • Public security work, such as CVEs, research, talks, or open-source tools, or certifications such as OSCP or OSWE.

Example Success Outcomes

  • An AppSec strategy tied to Security department KRs, with supporting work committed in other teams’ roadmaps.
  • A measurable drop in high-risk vulnerability classes, backed by shared guardrails or libraries.
  • AI-assisted AppSec workflows adopted by teams outside Security, with clear gains in speed or signal quality.

Our Tech Stack

React on the front end; Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch on the backend; Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform in infrastructure; GCP for cloud.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

AI Engineer - 4 Day Week + Remote

Ever wondered how it would be to revolutionise one of the least digitised industries in the market, alongside a growing and switched-on team? Read on!

___________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech and watch this video about what we are doing)

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and mission).

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 200 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job”, it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life:

- Connects us with meaningful relationships

- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans

- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

We are achieving this vision through the following two missions: 

1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation

2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

Laminar Projects is proud to be recognized as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Construction, Engineering & Property™ for 2024! Join a team where learning, collaboration, and growth are at the core of everything we do, and where solving big challenges is part of the fun.

___________________________________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

We are looking for an AI Engineer who combines deep knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) with strong software engineering skills and a pragmatic approach to product development. This person will help us design, build and deploy AI-powered features across Shape App and Channels, working closely with the Product and SRE Teams to define optimal solutions and ensure they run reliably in production.

You should be excited by the challenge of turning AI potential into real, useful features, for construction teams, and you should know when a small, lean approach is better than a large, complex one.

Team

You will join a team of product-minded software engineers, designers, and strategists focused on improving the way construction projects are delivered. You will work closely with Product Managers to shape AI features, and with our SRE Team to ensure production-readiness. You will be the go-to expert on AI/LLMs and play a key role in shaping our AI capability.

Your top 3 objectives

1. Design Lean, Fit-for-Purpose AI Solutions: Choose and implement the most appropriate AI/LLM approach for each use case, balancing quality, performance and cost.

2. Integrate AI-features into our Applications: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and iteration, using prompt engineering, model selection, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

3. Prepare for Production: Work with SREs to ensure AI features are reliable, scalable, observable, and secure in production.

Your top 5 responsibilities

1. Understand the Product Context: Work with product teams to translate user needs into clear AI opportunities and technical requirements.

2. Own the AI Feature Lifecycle: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and iteration, using prompt engineering, model selection, fine-tuning and evaluation.

3. Build AI-Backed Features: Contribute production-grade code that integrates AI capabilities into our apps, working alongside other engineers.

4. Guide Production Set-Up: Collaborate with SREs to define what infrastructure, observability, and scaling is required for each AI feature.

5. Stay Pragmatic and Up-to-Date: Continuously explore new development in LLMs and generative AI but always apply them with a product-first mindset.

Your Capabilities

You are a software engineer who understands how to use LLMs effectively, not just how to train them. You work well with ambiguity and know how to test your ideas quickly. You're comfortable collaborating with product teams and setting up production-grade systems.

As a candidate, you should have:

- Strong experience in applying LLMs and generative AI to real-world problems.

- Solid foundation in Phyton and ML frameworks (e.g. LangChain, Transformers, OpenAI APIs, etc.).

- Experience with multi-model evaluation and feedback loops.

- Production experience with embeddings, vector dabatases (like Pinecone, Weaviate or FAISS), and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.

- Familiarity with MLOps tooling and observability for inference pipelines.

- A bias for simplicity, clarity, and iterative delivery.

- The ability to communicate clearly with engineers, designers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have (If you don’t have it now you will after joining)

- Familiarity with production environments, APIs, and containerised systems (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Participation in AI communities, papers or OSS projects.

Shape isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:

- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge

- You like to be the smartest person in the room

- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback

- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

At Shape we value diverse experiences and perspectives, empowering each member to contribute their unique expertise towards our collective success, so if you don't think you meet all the criteria but still are excited about this role we encourage you to apply anyways!

___________________________________________________________________________________

Salary and Benefits

Standard Stuff

- Competitive salary dependent on location and capability

- Paid Annual Leave (Number of days will depend on where you are based) + statutory Bank Holidays

- In-House Coaching Sessions

- Discretionary bonus scheme for all team members.

The Life-Changing Stuff

- 4 Day Weeks: That’s right, 4 day weeks

- Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.

- Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Shape exists

- Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Shape. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Shape, development is unbounded

- Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

________________________________________________________________________________________

Application

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

- Why do you want to join us?

- If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders.

In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

jobs.description:
Strategy Analyst

About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Strategy Analyst, you will work directly alongside Alta Ares' Director of Strategy to support the company's most important strategic decisions from market positioning and competitive intelligence to fundraising preparation and institutional partnerships.

This is a high-exposure, high-output role. You will produce the analyses, frameworks, and documents that land on the CEO's desk and in front of investors and government partners. You will be expected to think rigorously, move fast, and communicate with clarity in a company where the stakes are real and the pace is unrelenting.

If you come from strategy consulting or a defence policy background and want to apply that rigour to one of Europe's most ambitious deeptech companies, this role is for you.

1. Strategic Analysis & Market Intelligence

  • Conduct in-depth analyses of defence markets, procurement trends, geopolitical dynamics, and competitive landscapes across Alta Ares' key geographies (Europe, US, UK, APAC)

  • Track and synthesise developments in defence policy, NATO priorities, EU defence funding mechanisms (EDF, EUDIS), and national defence budgets

  • Map competitive positioning across the global defence AI and autonomous systems ecosystem — Anduril, Palantir, Helsing, Shield AI, and emerging European players

  • Produce structured, actionable intelligence reports for the Director of Strategy and executive team

  • Monitor technology trends relevant to Alta Ares' product roadmap: AI/ML in defence, C-UAS, ISR, autonomous systems

2. Strategic Projects & Decision Support

  • Support the Director of Strategy on high-priority cross-functional projects: market entry analysis, partnership evaluation, product-market fit assessment, and build/buy/partner decisions

  • Build financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases to support strategic decisions

  • Prepare executive-level presentations and strategy documents for internal leadership, board meetings, and investor interactions

  • Conduct structured research and due diligence on potential partners, markets, and acquisition targets

  • Track OKRs and strategic initiative progress across the company on behalf of the Director of Strategy

3. Fundraising & Investor Support

  • Support the preparation of fundraising materials: investor decks, data room content, market sizing analyses, and competitive benchmarks

  • Conduct research on potential investors, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, and defence-focused VCs

  • Prepare briefing notes ahead of investor meetings and track follow-up commitments

  • Assist in responding to investor due diligence requests with structured, well-sourced analysis

4. Institutional & Partnership Intelligence

  • Research and map key institutional stakeholders across NATO, EU, and bilateral defence frameworks relevant to Alta Ares' commercial and policy agenda

jobs.description:
Advanced R&D - Physical Design Engineer

At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

Job title: Advanced R&D - Physical Design Engineer

Location : Lausanne, Switzerland

The Physical Design (PD) Engineer translates high-speed communication IP digital designs into physical GDSII layouts for advanced FinFET nodes. You will bridge logic design, owning block-to-chip implementation from netlist to final physical sign-off, ensuring PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) targets are met.

 

Immediate key objective

  • Drive block-level physical implementation—covering synthesis, SDC constraints, floorplanning, placement, CTS, and routing—meeting strict frequency, area, and power targets.

  • Execute timing closure across multiple corners and modes (MCMM) utilizing static timing analysis (STA) and generating targeted ECOs.

  • Drive full physical verification closure sign-off in deep-submicron FinFET technologies.

Responsibility

  • Own block synthesis, floorplanning, placement optimization, CTS, and routing.

  • Develop and refine SDC constraints to ensure design intent matches physical realization.

  • Collaborate with the digital design team to resolve logic or architectural bottlenecks affecting P&R convergence.

  • Generate progress reports, document implementation flows, and prepare sign-off packages for tape-out.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on physical design experience focusing on synthesis, SDC constraints, CTS, and place and route for high-speed systems.

  • Strong technical background in deep-submicron CMOS/FinFET physical effects, crosstalk, and high-frequency clock network design.

  • Proven experience of taking complex blocks from netlist through successful physical implementation.

  • Direct experience with advanced low-power implementation techniques (UPF, power gating).

  • Proven tape-out experience in advanced FinFET nodes (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, or 3nm).

  • Experience handling complex block-to-chip hierarchical assembly, pin placement, and top-level routing constraints..

Required Skills

  • Expert proficiency with industry-standard implementation and sign-off tools (e.g., Cadence Genus/Innovus/Tempus or Synopsys Design Compiler/ICC2/PrimeTime, and Calibre).

  • Deep understanding of SDC creation, and MCMM timing management.

  • Strong scripting skills (Tcl, Python) for flow automation and design data analysis.

  • Analytical mindset to debug congestion routing issues, and complex timing violations.

  • Self-motivated with strong sense of ownership; effective communicator and team player

Required Education

  • Masters or Ph.D. in E.E., Communications or other relevant fields

Partner Technical Manager

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

You will be the technical lead for Axon’s strategic system integrator relationships and the customer opportunities those partners bring. You stay with that work across the full cycle: first conversations, demonstrations, trials, senior engagements, and deployment when the situation requires it. You work across Axon, the partner and the end customer, understanding requirements and workflows, shaping how Axon technology and partner capability come together, and filling gaps so the work keeps moving.

This role sits in Global Sales Programs and Partnerships, the team building Axon’s partner-led model in regions where we grow with local system integrators. You will help those partners win and deliver outcomes with customers across Central and Eastern Europe, joining forces with colleagues who own the commercial relationship while you Own It technically from first conversation through to live use.

You will leave a visible mark on how Axon scales with partners: trusted technical relationships with both integrators and customers, clearer solutions, and a repeatable way of working that regional teams can rely on.

What You’ll Do

Location: Remotely from Warsaw, Poland, with regular travel across the region (approximately 40%)

Reports to: Senior Vice President, Global Sales Programs and Partners

Direct Reports: 0

  • Serve as the technical lead for assigned strategic system integrator relationships. Build a clear understanding of each partner’s technical capabilities: what they can position and deliver, where Axon needs to engage, and where delivery teams take over. Keep that picture current as the partnership grows.
  • Join partner-led and Axon-led customer engagements to capture requirements, explain Axon capabilities, and help shape a solution that fits the customer’s operational workflow.
  • Translate between Axon technology, the partner’s integration and service model, and the customer’s environment so all three parties share a clear technical picture.
  • Support partner-led opportunities through the full sales cycle: first conversations, demonstrations, trials, senior stakeholder engagements, and deployment where needed.
  • Build the partner’s ability to position Axon without deal-by-deal Axon coverage: technical enablement, reusable solution patterns, and plays the partner can take from one customer and country to the next.
  • Sit as the technical counterpart to the commercial partner lead: you own technical fit and partner capability; they own the relationship, pipeline and terms. Keep technical risk visible to that motion.
  • Maintain a direct technical relationship with end customers on partner-led accounts: understand their environment, stay close to how they use Axon, and be a named technical contact they can trust.
  • Where specialist teams are already engaged, you join forces with them. Where they are not, you fill the gap and keep the work moving: technical conversations, trials, deployment support, customer continuity, or whatever the situation requires.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role working with enterprise or government buyers, including holding a trusted technical relationship with the customer, ideally alongside system integrators or similar partners.
  • Comfort working across the full cycle, from first conversation to live use, and picking up the work when there is no one else to do it.
  • Experience sitting in the middle of a vendor, a partner and an end customer, aligning requirements, solving technical issues and keeping trust when the solution is not simple.

Senior DevOps Engineer

SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

jobs.title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)

Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

Focus

  • Integrate LLMs, memory, and external tools into systems that behave reliably under real-world conditions

  • Design real-time AI interactions with streaming, partial results, and tight latency constraints

  • Improve system reliability, observability, and fallback mechanisms

  • Collaborate closely with ML, backend, and product teams to ship features end-to-end

  • Continuously iterate based on real usage and failure modes

 

Ideal Experiences

Outcomes

  • Own and ship AI-native product features that move beyond chat into persistent, goal-driven workflows

  • Design and deploy agent workflows that reliably complete multi-step tasks across tools and sessions

  • Reduce latency and improve responsiveness of AI interactions while maintaining output quality

  • Build robust fallback and recovery mechanisms for LLM and tool failures in production environments

  • Improve the success rate and reliability of AI-driven workflows through iteration, evaluation, and monitoring

  • Contribute to a product experience where AI feels proactive, consistent, and dependable over time

 

Tech Stack

  • Next.js

jobs.description:
Stage Assistant - Analyste éthique et positionnement (H/F/X) - Paris

Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Assistant.e – Analyste éthique et positionnement (financements institutionnels et partenariats avec le secteur privé) / basé.e à Paris.

Le stage se déroulera au sein de l'Institut Humanitaire de Handicap International, dans une équipe de 3 personnes :

-        Une directrice de l’Institut

-        Deux analystes éthiques et positionnement, chacun.e référent.e, respectivement, pour :

Les partenariats opérationnels

Les financements institutionnels les partenariats avec le secteur privé

L’Institut a pour rôle de :

  • Fournir en interne des éléments d’analyse, de conseil et d’accompagnement concernant les enjeux éthiques et de positionnement d’HI ;
  • Contribuer au rayonnement et à l’influence d’HI pour les enjeux de solidarité internationale.

La mission principale du stage est de venir en appui à l’équipe de l’Institut sur ses projets de recherche et d’analyse sur des sujets liés à l’actualité géopolitique, ainsi qu’à l’éthique des financements institutionnels et des partenariats avec le secteur privé. Le stage vise à développer une capacité d’analyse critique et de raisonnement éthique appliqué : comprendre les tensions entre principes et réalités opérationnelles, identifier les risques et les dilemmes et contribuer à l’élaboration de recommandations utiles à la décision.

Dans ce cadre, les missions qui vous seront confiées sont les suivantes:

Activité 1 – Analyser les enjeux éthiques des partenariats avec le secteur privé

-        Réaliser des recherches approfondies sur les activités, les pratiques, les engagements et les controverses associés aux entités concernées.

-        Identifier et analyser les arguments en faveur ou en défaveur d’un partenariat en fonction de sa compatibilité avec les valeurs, principes humanitaires et engagements de HI.

-        Effectuer un suivi de l’évolution du droit de la Responsabilité Sociétale des Entreprises (RSE) et des pratiques des entités du secteur privé opérant dans des secteurs à risque.

Activité 2 – Analyser les enjeux éthiques des financements institutionnels

-        Réalise des recherches documentaires et des analyses sur les stratégies, priorités et mécanismes de financement des bailleurs institutionnels.

-        Identifier les dilemmes et risques éthiques susceptibles de découler de l’acceptation d’un financement, notamment au regard des principes humanitaires.

-        Participer à la formulation d’avis argumentés et de points de vigilance permettant d’éclairer les décisions de l’organisation.

Activité 3 – Contribuer à la formation interne et aux relations externes de l’Institut

-        Participer à la préparation et à l’animation de séquences de formation et à la présentation de travaux de l’Institut auprès des équipes internes.

Contribuer au développement des échanges avec des acteurs externes.

Requirements

Profil recherché:

Vous êtes issu d'une formation Master en en Action Humanitaire/Développement, Relations Internationales ou Droit International, ou toute autre formation permettant de mobiliser des connaissances en géopolitique et en droit international, avec un intérêt particulier pour les enjeux humanitaires, les enjeux opérationnels en zone d'urgence et l’éthique.

Vous êtes familier avec le milieu de la solidarité internationale (ONGI, UN, association nationale/locale…);

Une expérience préalable à l’étranger et l’engagement dans le milieu associatif sont valorisés

Analyse, recherche et rédaction

-        Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais.

-        Capacité à conduire une recherche documentaire approfondie, à croiser des sources de nature différente, à en apprécier la fiabilité.

-        Capacité à construire une argumentation rigoureuse et à formuler des analyses et recommandations.

Connaissances géopolitiques et juridiques

-        Bonne connaissance des dynamiques géopolitiques contemporaines des transformations du système international.

-        Connaissance des principaux cadres du droit international, en particulier du droit international humanitaire.

-        Compréhension des principes humanitaires et des enjeux liés à leur application opérationnelle.

Éthique appliquée et positionnement organisationnel

-        Intérêt pour l’analyse des dilemmes éthiques rencontrés par les organisations humanitaires.

-        Capacité à examiner différentes options et à expliciter les arguments en présence.

Benefits

Durée: 6 mois

Date de démarrage : à partir du 04/01/2027

- Tickets restaurant d’une valeur faciale de 8,96 euros (60 % à la charge de l’employeur, 40% à votre charge)

Vous devez disposer d’une convention de stage obligatoire délivrée par un établissement d’enseignement ou de formation français.

Senior Developer Community Manager

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Developer Community Manager to help us better engage and connect with the global community of developers and AI practitioners building with Mistral. This is a builder role. Some programs exist in early form; others don't exist yet. You'll design them from scratch, launch them, measure them and scale what works: ambassador and champion programs, creator and influencer partnerships, social-led campaigns, and the day-to-day welcome that turns a first API call into a lasting relationship. Head of Compliance

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

jobs.description:
Support Medewerker

Maak het verschil als Support Medewerker in IJsselstein

Als Support Medewerker zorg jij ervoor dat klanten optimaal gebruik kunnen maken van de software van CARAT. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor keukenwinkels, grote ketens en andere handelspartners. Je beantwoordt vragen, onderzoekt softwareproblemen en zorgt voor passende oplossingen. Veel vragen handel je zelfstandig af. Bij complexere vraagstukken werk je samen met supportcollega's en softwareontwikkelaars in Duitsland. Je houdt overzicht over openstaande verzoeken en zorgt voor een zorgvuldige opvolging. Ondertussen verdiep je je steeds verder in de software en draag je bij aan de verdere groei van CARAT in Nederland. Op termijn krijg je bovendien de mogelijkheid om jouw kennis en expertise te delen met klanten door het verzorgen van trainingen en workshops, als je daar energie van krijgt.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • beantwoorden van klantvragen via telefoon en e-mail;

  • analyseren en oplossen van softwareproblemen binnen de eerste- en tweedelijnssupport;

  • registreren, verwerken en opvolgen van verzoeken in het ticketsysteem;

  • afstemmen van complexere vraagstukken met collega's en softwareontwikkelaars in Duitsland;

  • verder ontwikkelen van jouw kennis van CARAT-software en ERP- en CRM-systemen.

Als enthousiaste Support Medewerker kun jij rekenen op:

Een afwisselende functie binnen een internationale organisatie waar zelfstandigheid en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. CARAT biedt een prettige werkomgeving met korte communicatielijnen en betrokken collega's. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw kennis te vergroten en door te groeien binnen een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

  • een contract voor onbepaalde tijd op basis van 40 uur per week;

  • 30 vakantiedagen;

  • de mogelijkheid om 3 dagen per week thuis te werken;

  • een laptop voor thuis en op kantoor;

  • doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • een internationale werkomgeving met korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je bent klantgericht, denkt zakelijk en vindt het leuk om klanten te ondersteunen bij het oplossen van vraagstukken rondom software en bedrijfsprocessen. Daarbij kan je aandachtig luisteren en stel je de juiste vragen. Je kan hierbij oplossingen duidelijk en begrijpelijk overbrengen. Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd en bent bedreven in het omgaan met ERP- en CRM-systemen. Je wil graag leren en bent bereid om kennis op te doen over de keuken-, badkamer- en meubelbranche.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

•Afgeronde commerciële opleiding of vergelijkbare commerciële opleiding;

•Bij voorkeur 2–3 jaar relevante ervaring in klantenservice, verkoopondersteuning, applicatieondersteuning of een vergelijkbare klantgerichte functie;

•Ervaring met ERP- en CRM-systemen;

•Ervaring met MS Office; kennis van TeamViewer of vergelijkbare tools voor onderhoud op afstand is een pré;

•Uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands;

•Praktische kennis van het Duits, voldoende om deel te nemen aan interne vergaderingen en klantvragen duidelijk te communiceren;

•Een goede kennis van het Engels op conversatieniveau is voldoende;

•Ervaring in de keuken-, badkamer-, tegel- of meubelbranche is een pluspunt, maar geen vereiste;

•Klantgericht, rustig en oplossingsgericht, ook bij het omgaan met veeleisende vragen

Jouw werkgebied

Je standplaats is IJsselstein, waar CARAT gebruikmaakt van de kantoorruimte van MHK Nederland. De locatie is goed bereikbaar vanuit onder andere Utrecht, Nieuwegein, Houten en Woerden. Je werkt in een hybride omgeving, waarbij je in overleg maximaal drie dagen per week vanuit huis kunt werken. Op kantoor ontmoet je jouw Nederlandse collega's en is er ruimte om kennis te delen en samen te werken.

Werken bij CARAT

CARAT ontwikkelt software voor de keukenbranche en is onderdeel van de internationale MHK-groep. De 3D-keukenontwerpsoftware van CARAT wordt door meer dan 50.000 gebruikers gebruikt en heeft een marktleidende positie. De oplossingen ondersteunen keukenhandelaren bij het ontwerpen, verkopen en bestellen van keukens. Daarnaast investeert CARAT in de verdere ontwikkeling van ERP- en CRM-oplossingen.

In Nederland werk je binnen een klein, betrokken team dat nauw samenwerkt met collega's in Duitsland. De werksfeer is informeel, nuchter en persoonlijk. Collega's zijn toegankelijk, de communicatielijnen zijn kort en er is veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid. Persoonlijke ontwikkeling en een prettige samenwerking staan centraal.

jobs.description:
Agentic AI Technical Mentor - Independent Contractor (US Canada, Europe, MENA, APAC)

About Us

Udacity is now an Accenture company, and exciting things are happening! 🚀 We are on a mission of forging futures in tech through radical talent transformation in digital technologies. We offer a unique and immersive online learning platform, powering corporate technical training in fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Autonomous Systems, Cloud Computing and more. Our rapidly growing global organization is revolutionizing how the enterprise market bridges the talent shortage and skills gaps during their digital transformation journey.

Recognized for its innovative impact, Udacity part of Accenture continues to empower people with the skills they need to secure the jobs they want.

Our School of AI is committed to providing high-quality upskilling opportunities in this rapidly evolving field. We regularly launch new projects and are seeking experienced mentors to join us as external contractors to support our programs and learners.

As new initiatives arise, we will reach out to qualified candidates within this talent pool to provide details on project scope, expected timelines, and compensation. If you are passionate about tackling meaningful challenges and making a difference we invite you to apply and explore this opportunity to collaborate with us.

You’ll be an excellent fit if you have:

  • Proven technical expertise with 5+ years of experience in the relevant field
  • A passion for mentoring and helping others succeed in their learning
  • Excellent interpersonal skills. You enjoy building relationships, communicating effectively, and fostering a positive learning environment
  • A deep understanding of the tech industry and emerging trends in AI and related fields
  • The flexibility to work part-time as an external contractor alongside your current commitments

Mandatory Technical Skills - Agentic AI

    • Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic reasoning frameworks such as CoT and ReAct

    • Experience designing and implementing prompt chains, role-based prompts, feedback loops, and iterative prompt refinement

    • Hands-on experience building agentic workflows, including task routing, orchestration, sequential workflows, parallel workflows, and reflective AI workflows

    • Ability to design and implement AI agents with tool use, API integrations, structured outputs, memory, state management, and database interaction

    • Experience with RAG-based agent systems, including single-agent and multi-agent RAG implementations

    • Knowledge of AI agent evaluation, including testing, debugging, and improving agent performance

    • Understanding of multi-agent system design, including orchestration, routing, state coordination, and multi-agent architectures

    • Ability to explain complex Agentic AI concepts clearly through instruction, demos, and learner support

Responsibilities:

Your responsibilities as a technical mentor will be divided into three major tasks.

  1. 1:1 video calls
  2. Virtual Technical Deep-Dive Sessions
  3. Group Q&A sessions

Personal 1:1 Session:

  • Provide personalized support by addressing learner questions related to course content and projects.
  • Prior to the call mentors are expected to review the students' previous project submission(s) - provided by the Mentor Success Team when available - and/or any specific areas of the Nanodegree content or project that the student has expressed confusion or difficulty with.

Technical Deep-Dive Session:

  • For concept deep-dives, mentors will come prepared with a slide presentation that reviews a Nanodegree concept in more detail, share different use-cases for the concept to broaden student perspectives and understanding, and hold a Q&A session with the learners.
  • For project walkthroughs, a mentor will come prepared with a slide presentation that outlines each element of the rubric to help learners understand expectations and typical problem areas they may encounter. This can include a mentor “grading” a sample submission to demonstrate what mentors are looking for when reviewing projects.

Group Q&A Session:

  • Host regular sessions (via Slack or video) to address learner queries related to projects and coursework. No prior preparation required.

Why should you apply?

  • Make an impact by mentoring and contributing to a vibrant, global learning community
  • Showcase your expertise and gain recognition for your technical knowledge
  • Learn and network with our global community of mentors while staying ahead of the curve on cutting-edge technologies
  • Earn additional income with the flexibility to work on your own schedule

Mentoring at Udacity offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of learners and to contribute to achieving our mission.

If you're passionate about learning, technology and want to make a positive impact, we encourage you to apply to become a mentor at Udacity part of Accenture.
