jobs.title: Team Lead SEA / Google Ads (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Team Lead SEA / Google Ads (m/w/d)

Für unseren Kunden munique suchen wir die Person, die den umsatzstärksten E-Commerce-Kunden der Agentur übernimmt, das SEA-Team führt und mit den Gründern das Produkt rund um Automatisierung und KI baut.

Google Ads verändert sich gerade schneller als in den zehn Jahren davor. Performance Max, Demand Gen und KI-Bidding nehmen Handgriffe ab, die früher den Job ausgemacht haben — und belohnen die, die Systeme bauen statt Kampagnen zu verwalten. Genau da will unser Kunde munique vorne sein.

Für munique, eine Performance-Boutique aus München, suchen wir deshalb die Person, die das SEA fachlich anführt: Du übernimmst den umsatzstärksten Kunden der Agentur mit Konten von 30–50+ Kampagnen und Jahresbudgets ab 1 Mio. €, führst ein Team von drei SEA-Leuten und treibst als Product Owner fünf bis sechs Automatisierungs- und KI-Projekte voran, die sofort bereitliegen.

Und das nicht aus einer Konzernstruktur heraus: munique hat rund 30 Mitarbeitende, du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern, bist Teil des Leadership-Kreises — und bestimmst selbst, wann und wo du arbeitest.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

Das SEA-Team von munique arbeitet für Marken wie arena, Hessnatur, KIA und Luis Trenker. Für den wichtigsten Kunden und die Weiterentwicklung des ganzen Bereichs wird jetzt die fachliche Spitze neu besetzt.

Gleichzeitig will munique, dass Automatisierung und KI nicht Präsentationsfolie bleiben, sondern die Kundenarbeit messbar besser machen. Dafür braucht es jemanden, der beides kann: tief im Account und mit Lust, das System dahinter zu bauen.

Was du bewegen wirst

Nicht als Aufgabenliste, sondern als das, was in zwölf Monaten anders sein soll:

  • Der Top-Kunde wächst mit dir. Du hast den Account in einer geordneten Übergabe übernommen, führst Performance-Meetings, Jahres-Kick-off und Quarterly — und kannst an Kennzahlen zeigen, was sich verbessert hat.

  • Du bist selbst im Account. Shopping, Performance Max, Search, Demand Gen und YouTube laufen mit sauberem Tracking, Bidding und Feed — und du weißt, warum.

  • Dein Team ist stärker als vorher. Du hast Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche geführt, Auslastung geplant und Personalbedarf in die Leadership-Planung eingebracht.

  • Die ersten KI-Projekte sind live. Neue Google- und Meta-Features sind getestet und in die Kundenarbeit überführt, das eigene Reporting von munique auf ETL-Basis ist weiterentwickelt.

  • Die Kunden wachsen weiter. Du erkennst Potenziale bei Bestandskund:innen und bringst dich bei Pitches und Upselling ein.

Wie bei munique gearbeitet wird

munique ist bewusst eine Boutique: wenige, ausgewählte Kunden, individuelle Strategien statt Standardlösungen. Das Arbeitsmodell fühlt sich an wie Freelancing — mit der Sicherheit einer Festanstellung. Eine Kollegin, die aus der Selbstständigkeit kam, sagt: Beim Wechsel hat sich für sie fast nichts verändert.

  • Zeit und Ort entscheidest du. Jede Woche, jeden Tag individuell — erwartet wird Erreichbarkeit an fünf Tagen, nicht Anwesenheit.

  • Freie Tage legst du selbst fest. Urlaub ohne feste Obergrenze.

  • Jede Stunde zählt. Bedingungsloses Grundgehalt plus Stundenlohn — Mehrstunden werden voll vergütet, dazu ein Bonus an Zielen und Unternehmensergebnis.

  • Mut ist einer der vier Werte von munique. Neue Plattformfunktionen werden früh getestet, daraus wird gelernt — und was wirkt, kommt in die Praxis.

Wen wir suchen

Jemanden, der SEA seit Jahren selbst macht, schon geführt hat — und beides weiter tun will.

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Google Ads / SEA als Kernaufgabe Du hast ein Team disziplinarisch geführt (mindestens zwei bis drei Personen) und Entwicklungsgespräche selbst verantwortet.

  • Du hast große Konten gesteuert — 30–50+ Kampagnen, siebenstellige Jahresbudgets — und kannst an einem Beispiel erklären, was du verändert hast und was es gebracht hat.

  • Du kannst einen anspruchsvollen Kunden eigenständig führen, strategisch wie im Tagesgeschäft.

  • Du willst weiterhin selbst operativ arbeiten — Führung ist für dich ein Zusatz, kein Ausstieg aus dem Account.

Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Du kennst die Entwicklung der letzten zehn Jahre im SEA-Bereich

  • E-Commerce-Schwerpunkt mit Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen und YouTube

  • Tiefe in Tracking, Conversions, Bidding und Produktfeed

  • Du hast schon eine Automatisierung, ein Script oder ein neues Feature erfolgreich eingeführt

  • Erfahrung aus einer Agentur oder als Freelancer:in

Die Vorteile für dich

  • Abwechslung statt Brandseite — mehrere Marken und Accounts statt jahrelang immer derselbe, inklusive des umsatzstärksten Kunden der Agentur

  • Sparring mit dem Gründer, der SEA selbst kann — als Teamlead wirst du gecoacht und weiterentwickelt, statt allein an der Spitze zu stehen

  • Freelance-Freiheit mit Festanstellung — Arbeitszeit, Ort und freie Tage bestimmst du selbst, Büro in München, remote möglich

  • Grundgehalt plus Stundenlohn — jede Mehrstunde wird bezahlt, dazu ein Bonus an Zielen und Unternehmensergebnis

  • Gestaltung statt Verwaltung — Product Owner für 5–6 Automatisierungs- und KI-Projekte, direkt mit den Gründern

  • Monatliches Extra nach der Probezeit: Wellpass oder Spendit, dazu ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung und zwei bezahlte Tage fürs Ehrenamt

  • Lernen im Team mit Drive — Kolleg:innen, die sich ständig weiterbilden, munique Academy, Peer-Sparring und die Community munique minds

So läuft der Prozess

Der Prozess ist schlank — kein Case, in der Regel rund vier Wochen bis zum Vertragsentwurf.

  1. Kurzes Telefonat mit uns (15 Minuten): passt die Rolle zu dem, was du suchst?

  2. Ausführliches Kennenlernen mit uns (45–60 Minuten) — deine Erfahrung, deine Motivation, deine Fragen.

  3. Online-Interview bei munique, danach persönliche Gespräche mit den Geschäftsführern, HR und jemandem aus dem Team.

  4. Abschlussgespräch zu Vertrag und Konditionen.

Warum du dich jetzt melden solltest

Top-Kunde, eigenes Team und ein KI-Produkt, das du mitbaust — diese Kombination gibt es in großen Agenturen selten, und mit dieser Freiheit fast nie. Wenn du SEA seit Jahren selbst machst und schon geführt hast, ist das die Rolle, in der beides zählt. Ein Gespräch von 15 Minuten reicht, um herauszufinden, ob es passt.

Kontakt

Wir begleiten munique bei dieser Besetzung. Fragen zur Rolle, zur Vergütung oder zum Prozess gehen direkt an:

Sören Gerdes · Recruiter · A-Level · -----

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for the business objectives your customers set to achieve through their AI transformation journey.

This is not the SAAS CSM role we know. Rather than driving adoption and holding the relationship, you reverse-engineer the use cases a customer already runs on the platform and agentify them: you take an existing business process and drive it into the AI era, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and applied AI work together. You build beside the customer’s own team until the workflow runs. It requires a can-do mindset, strong business acumen backed by technical fluency.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Munich office.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate use cases: Inventory the use cases an account already runs and agentify them, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and agents work together.

  • Diagnose workflows: Map where decisions get made and work moves forward, and turn it into a sequenced transformation plan with the customer’s executives and process owners.

  • Build beside the customer: Run working sessions where the customer’s own team builds the workflow, and stay in the room until it runs.

  • Route by account maturity: Use the account maturity audit and Path A readiness to decide what gets built beside the customer and what becomes a scoped engagement.

  • Partner on services: Source engagements for Deployment Strategy with the business context established, and stay connected through delivery so every build lands back into the account plan.

  • Forecast outcomes: Forecast credit burn against entitlement at business-unit level, and diagnose any shortfall: an unbuilt workflow, an unadopted one, or a process that never changed.

  • Advise on governance: Own the permissioning, data boundaries, agent oversight, and approvals that move agents from pilot to production.

  • Lead change with sponsors: Hold the relationships with the sponsors who drive change, tie every workflow to the outcome they need to show, and lead the operating-model shift that makes it stick.

  • Prepare renewals: Evidence delivered outcomes on the T-120/90/60/30 cadence, and surface risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner early enough to act.

How Success Is Measured

The core success component is our ability to drive business outcomes for our customers through the different monday.com layers of operations.

But when breaking it down to the actual day2day we can find :

* Retention of all paid components: seats, AI credits, and services.
* AI consumption growth: adoption of AI capabilities into new and existing use cases, measured as credit burn against entitlement across the account.
*Growth in new AI capabilities usage that drives commercial growth.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience

  • Experience in customer success, consulting, solutions, or a similar customer-facing role in SaaS, ideally with enterprise accounts.

  • Ability to diagnose how a business process really runs and redesign it with AI and humans working together.

  • Hands-on experience building workflows, automations, or AI agents, and comfort building alongside customers rather than only advising.

  • Credibility with multiple business owners and executives, not only IT or platform owners.

  • Strong commercial and analytical skills: tying usage to business outcomes, forecasting consumption against entitlement, and making a renewal case with evidence.

  • Working knowledge of applied AI governance topics such as permissioning, data boundaries, platform automation, LLMs and agent oversight.

  • Clear communication and the ability to lead change with sponsors across a customer organisation.

  • Experience with high-paced operations and large enterprise customers is an advantage.

jobs.title: Restaurant Operations - Cologne/Düsseldorf
jobs.description:
Restaurant Operations - Cologne/Düsseldorf

About Us

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

 

About the Role:

We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others.

Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it.

What You’ll Do:

Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city:

  • Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team

  • Problem-solve for our merchants on the ground while running live operations

  • Support restaurants after the go live and make sure that Tebi adds value to their business long-term

  • Find opportunities for improvement in our process, materials and systems

  • Continue investing in our relationship with our merchants to make sure they are happy with our product and growing as a business

  • Identify product and process gaps and bring it to internal central teams such as product, engineering and central operations

What You’ll Need:

  • You are a creative problem solver who enjoys interacting with hospitality businesses

  • You are empathetic towards our merchants and curious about their business

  • You can juggle multiple things at once and bring structure

  • Curious about the product, want to be an expert in Tebi system and can apply your knowledge

  • Good communication - you are great at proactive contact and managing expectations

  • Being comfortable with high-pace environments: both the hospitality flow and the startup day-to-day

  • Interest in data, process improvement and automation

  • Flexibility in working hours that fit our merchants’ needs and ensuring a healthy balance

  • At least 2-4 years of experience in hospitality, early startup operations, fast-paced account management or customer operations

  • You are comfortable working in both English and German

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Flexible Time-off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Developer

Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

  • You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

  • You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

  • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

  • You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

  • You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

  • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

  • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

  • English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

  • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

  • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

  • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

  • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts

  • Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

  • Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

  • Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

  • Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

  • Pensum: 100%

  • Start: As soon as possible

  • Language: English; German a plus

  • Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

  • Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

  • Create engaging ways to show our product

  • Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

  • Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

  • Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

  • Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

  • Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path


What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

  • Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

  • Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

  • Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

  • Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

  • A minimum of 1 year of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

  • You are comfortable working in both English and Dutch

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

Shape the future of innovation as we tackle cutting-edge projects that make a difference. We’re not just in the business of engineering—we’re building a brighter future. Driven by creativity and a culture of excellence, we believe in the power of engineering to solve today’s challenges and create opportunities for tomorrow. What we do matters.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions (QDSS) is seeking an experienced Systems Nuclear Engineer to support the design, modernization, and modification of complex nuclear power plant systems. This role will work across multidisciplinary engineering teams to evaluate plant-level requirements, support system and subsystem design, and ensure proposed changes meet applicable safety, regulatory, licensing, and operational requirements.

This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States. Candidates must be US Citizens or US Permanent Residents.

The ideal candidate will bring strong nuclear power design engineering experience with specific knowledge of Boiling Water Reactor (BWR) plants. This position requires a systems-level understanding of how mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and controls (I&C), software, hardware, and FPGA-based systems interact within a nuclear power environment. Experience with reactor protection, nuclear I&C, plant modernization, and legacy GE BWR architectures is highly valued.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Translate plant-level, operational, and nuclear safety requirements into allocated system and subsystem requirements.
  • Decompose and allocate requirements across mechanical, electrical, hardware, software, FPGA, instrumentation, and control implementations.
  • Develop, maintain, and review system descriptions, design specifications, interface requirements, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), cabinet drawings, elementary drawings, and connection/route drawings.
  • Evaluate proposed changes to mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, control, protection, and safety systems.
  • Support the development and review of engineering change packages and plant design modifications.
  • Perform requirements quality, completeness, consistency, and traceability reviews.
  • Participate in technical and design reviews, Technical Specification markups, and licensing-related reviews.
  • Evaluate potential nuclear safety, design-basis, and licensing impacts associated with design changes.
  • Support resolution of technical issues, test anomalies, nonconformances, and design discrepancies.
  • Perform or support functional analysis, requirements analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA/FMECA), single-failure analysis, and design-basis evaluations.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure system interfaces and requirements are properly understood and implemented.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nuclear, Systems, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 10+ years of nuclear power plant design engineering experience, preferably with GE-designed Boiling Water Reactors (BWRs).
  • Solid knowledge of Reactor Protection Systems (RPS), Instrumentation & Controls (I&C), neutron monitoring, safety-related instrumentation, trip logic, and digital/analog control systems, including NUMAC or comparable GE platforms.
  • Understanding of BWR design and licensing requirements, safety classifications, equipment/environmental qualification, seismic requirements, failure analysis, Technical Specifications, and surveillance requirements.
  • Experience with engineering requirements analysis, FMEA/FMECA, single-failure analysis, and design-basis evaluations.
  • Ability to assess plant system interactions, evaluate legacy GE BWR designs, support design changes, and document nuclear safety and licensing impacts.
  • Strong technical writing, requirements development, and cross-disciplinary collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct GE BWR design experience or previous GE Vernova / GE Hitachi engineering experience.
  • Reactor protection, Emergency Core Cooling System (ECCS), digital I&C, NUMAC, or legacy GE I&C experience.
  • BWR plant modifications, modernization, system safety, or failure analysis experience.
  • Experience working under NQA-1 and 10 CFR 50 Appendix B quality programs.

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future.

Full compensation package is based on candidate experience and certifications

jobs.title: Werkstudent*in Embedded Software
jobs.description:
Werkstudent*in Embedded Software

Ein guter Sensor fällt im Alltag nicht auf, weil die Software dahinter einfach zuverlässig läuft. Genau daran arbeitest du bei uns in Wedel, neben deinem Studium. Dein Code landet nicht irgendwo in der Schublade, sondern in Maschinen, die jeden Tag funktionieren müssen. Wenn dir das mehr bedeutet als ein Vorzeigeprojekt, bist du hier richtig.

Wir bei TWK entwickeln und produzieren seit über 60 Jahren im Wachstumsmarkt der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik kundenspezifische Sensoren für den Anlagen- und Maschinenbau. Funktionale Sicherheit für Mensch und Maschine ist unser Anspruch – und der lässt sich nicht mit halbgaren Lösungen oder endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen erfüllen.

Wenn du Lust hast, Software zu schreiben, die in echten Maschinen zuverlässig arbeitet, dann lass uns sprechen. Schick uns deine Unterlagen und ein paar Sätze dazu, was dich an Embedded Software reizt.

Aufgaben

Von Beginn an arbeitest du an echten Aufgaben, die direkt in unsere Sensoren und Maschinen einfließen:

  • Mitarbeit an der Entwicklung von Embedded Software auf ARM-Cortex-Mikrocontrollern, vorrangig STM32

  • Weiterentwicklung bestehender Firmware und Sensor-Bibliotheken

  • Unterstützung bei der Anbindung von Schnittstellen wie CANopen, IO-Link, Profinet oder EtherCAT

  • Mitarbeit beim Testen von Software- und Hardwaremodulen

  • Dokumentation der Ergebnisse im Kontext funktionaler Sicherheit

  • Gemeinsame Code Reviews im Team, bei denen du mitlernst und mitgestaltest

  • Schrittweise Übernahme eigener Teilaufgaben mit Unterstützung aus dem Team

  • Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams

Qualifikationen

  • Du hast Lust, Dinge wirklich zu durchdenken, und bringst dafür folgende Grundlagen mit:

  • Eingeschriebene*r Student*in der Informatik, technischen Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder Systemtechnik

  • Erste Erfahrung in der Embedded-Software-Entwicklung, idealerweise aus Studium oder Projekten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit C; Kenntnisse in Python, .NET oder C# sind von Vorteil

  • Eigenständige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Blick aufs Ganze

  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Freude am Austausch über Ergebnisse

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Präzise und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Kenntnisse in Buskommunikation oder Funksystemen – von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit Echtzeitbetriebssystemen auf Mikrocontrollern – von Vorteil

  • Vertrautheit mit Git als Versionsverwaltungssystem – von Vorteil

Benefits

Wir sind ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen, das Wert auf kurze Entscheidungswege und eine “Open-Door-Mentalität“ legt. Unser Team profitiert von einer wertschätzenden Unternehmenskultur, in der die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf großgeschrieben wird. Neben abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden zahlreiche Benefits:

  • Persönliches Mentoring – schneller ankommen, schneller wachsen

  • Option auf Abschlussarbeit und Übernahme – wir denken über den Campus hinaus

  • Firmenevents – vernetzen, feiern, wachsen

  • Firmenfitness über Wellhub – Zugang zu Partner-Studios, Online-Classes und Wellness, flexibel nutzbar.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote-Optionen – damit Studium und Job entspannt zusammenpassen

Bewerbung und Ablauf

Nach Eingang deiner Bewerbung bekommst du innerhalb einer Woche eine Antwort von Christine, Betül oder Alina. Das erste Kennenlerngespräch findet in der Regel online über MS-Teams statt. Im zweiten Schritt laden wir dich meist persönlich zu uns vor Ort ein. Ganz unkompliziert.

Dein Interesse ist geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams. Bei uns erwartet dich ein motiviertes Team, spannende Herausforderungen und die Möglichkeit, dich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du hast Fragen? Schreib uns direkt- wir melden uns.

jobs.description:
(Senior) IT Security Consultant – Vulnerability Management & Container Security (m/w/d)

Du möchtest Sicherheitslücken nicht nur identifizieren, sondern deren Analyse, Bewertung und Behebung durch intelligente Prozesse und Automatisierung nachhaltig verbessern? Du arbeitest gerne hands-on mit Security-Tools, APIs und Container-Technologien und möchtest auch KI gezielt für effizientere Security-Prozesse einsetzen?

Mit langjähriger Beratungserfahrung, agilen Arbeitsweisen und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden branchenneutral und herstellerunabhängig.

Wir legen großen Wert auf kollegiale Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und eine offene Feedbackkultur. Bei komplexen Aufgaben findest du immer Unterstützung im Team.

Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst, bewertest und priorisierst Sicherheitslücken anhand von CVE, CVSS, Exploitability und dem jeweiligen Risikokontext und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Du implementierst, konfigurierst und entwickelst Vulnerability-Management-Plattformen wie DefectDojo weiter, um Schwachstellen zentral zu erfassen, zu bewerten und nachzuverfolgen.

  • Du integrierst unterschiedliche Security-Scanner und optimierst die Konsolidierung, Normalisierung und Deduplizierung von Security Findings.

  • Du entwickelst und automatisierst Security-Workflows für die Bewertung, Zuordnung und Nachverfolgung von Schwachstellen und setzt dafür APIs, Skripte und geeignete Schnittstellen ein.

  • Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Ansätze zur Analyse, Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Security Findings und integrierst diese in bestehende Security-Prozesse.

  • Du analysierst und sicherst Kubernetes- und OpenShift-Umgebungen ab, identifizierst Schwachstellen in Container-Infrastrukturen und setzt Maßnahmen für Container Hardening und sichere Konfigurationen um.

  • Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung technischer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen und unterstützt sie dabei, ihr Vulnerability Management nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Gemeinsam suchen wir nach Projekten, die zu deinen Interessen und Stärken passen.

Qualifikation

Deine Fähigkeiten (wichtig für uns)

Für uns ist es wichtig, dass Du Spaß daran hast, Neues zu lernen und Dein Wissen weiterzugeben.

Das wünschen wir uns von Dir:

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Vulnerability Management und in der operativen IT Security und bist mit der technischen Analyse, Bewertung und Bearbeitung von Sicherheitslücken vertraut.

  • Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in DefectDojo oder vergleichbaren Vulnerability-Management-Lösungen und Erfahrung mit der Integration von Security-Scannern sowie der Verarbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Findings.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit CVE, CVSS und risikobasierter Schwachstellenbewertung und kannst technische Risiken unter Berücksichtigung von Exploitability und Sicherheitskontext fundiert priorisieren.

  • Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in Kubernetes, OpenShift und Container Security mit und hast Erfahrung in der Analyse und Absicherung containerbasierter Umgebungen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit API-Integrationen, Skripting und der Automatisierung von Security-Prozessen. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und hands-on und setzt technische Lösungen eigenständig um.

Deine Fähigkeiten (nice to have)

Über folgenden Fähigkeiten von Dir freuen wir uns, ansonsten erlernst Du die Aspekte im Rahmen der Einarbeitung:

  • Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit KI- und LLM-Technologien und hast diese bereits zur Security-Analyse, Klassifizierung von Findings oder Automatisierung von Workflows eingesetzt.

  • Du besitzt gute Python-Kenntnisse und hast Erfahrung mit Security-Tools wie Trivy, Grype, OWASP Dependency-Track oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.

  • Du kennst dich mit Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), Software Supply Chain Security und Open Source Vulnerability Management aus.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Kubernetes-Sicherheitskonzepten wie RBAC, Network Policies, Pod Security Standards oder CIS Benchmarks.

  • Du bringst Kenntnisse in DevSecOps und CI/CD-Security mit und hast idealerweise bereits Security-Scans in automatisierte Build- und Deployment-Pipelines integriert.

Falls du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung.

Benefits

  • Selbstverwirklichung: Freiraum zum Ausprobieren, eine offene Fehlerkultur und die Mitgestaltung von Strukturen im Unternehmen sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

  • Dein Weg zur Expertin/zum Experten: Unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden begleiten Dich bei Deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Arbeite in Deiner produktiven Zeit und plane private Verpflichtungen flexibel ein. Mehrarbeit wird ausgeglichen.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Du hast die Wahl zwischen verschiedenen Angeboten wie
    Deutschland-Jobticket, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Kitaplatzes
    Förderung oder Job Rad.

  • Weiterbildungen: Wir investieren in Deine Entwicklung durch regelmäßige Weiterbildungen und renommierte Zertifizierungen.

  • Individuelle Hardware-Auswahl: Du entscheidest, welche Hardware Du nutzen möchtest.

  • Geringe Reisetätigkeit: Wir arbeiten remote oder in unseren Büros in Köln oder Essen. Besprechungen vor-Ort beim Kunden sind bei uns die Ausnahme.

  • Teambuilding: Unser monatlicher Open Space dient der kreativen Arbeit an aktuellen Themen. Regelmäßige Events (z.B. gemeinsame Workation, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier) werden vom Team selbst geplant und umgesetzt.

  • Workation: Kombiniere Arbeit und Reisen oder nimm Dir eine längere Auszeit im Rahmen eines Sabbaticals.

  • Urlaub: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr und Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe.

Du brennst für Cyber Security und bist begeistert, Teil eines starken und diversen Teams zu sein, in dem auch der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt. Wenn Du unser Unternehmen langfristig mitgestalten möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist schlank und unkompliziert. Es erwarten Dich keine endlosen Fragerunden oder Assessment Center. Im Interview geht es uns vor allem um den lockeren Austausch und das gegenseitige Kennenlernen.

Schick uns lediglich einen kurzen Lebenslauf mit den wichtigsten Stationen, die für die Stellenausschreibung relevant sind. Wir melden uns umgehend zurück und vereinbaren einen Termin via Microsoft Teams.

jobs.title: Senior Data Collection Operator (FR)
jobs.description:
Senior Data Collection Operator (FR)

About Genesis

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

The role

General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too.

You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area.

You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently.

What you will do

  • Help lead the Paris data collection floor. Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection work and help the team scale effectively.

  • Own complex collection setups. Take a loosely defined request and turn it into a working, repeatable collection task, including the setup, fixtures, props, environment, and procedure, with minimal support from engineering.

  • Create high-quality training data. Wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and produce precise demonstrations that can be used to train our models.

  • Own the full collection workflow. Go beyond collecting the data itself: review and quality-check your work, identify unusable episodes, support annotation, and help ensure that what reaches research is trainable data.

  • Build repeatable tasks. Turn new collection requests into clear, repeatable processes that can be executed consistently by other operators.

  • Partner with research and model engineering. Translate their requests into physical collection tasks, share observations from the floor, and iterate with them on setups and collection strategy.

  • Improve the operation. Identify when a fixture, station layout, procedure, or collection method can be improved and proactively help implement those improvements.

  • Write and improve the playbook. Own SOPs, quality checks, and training materials that allow the Paris operation to scale while maintaining a consistent quality bar.

  • Guide other operators. Help onboard, train, and mentor operators and reinforce consistent execution across the team.

  • Run real-robot testing. Partner with reliability and engineering teams to test robots on the floor, document what you observe, and help surface issues.

  • Own quality. Review your own work and the team's, take direct feedback, and keep raising the bar.

What we are looking for

  • You have done precise, repetitive physical work to a high quality bar and can explain what made your work good and how you measured it. This could include data collection, teleoperation, motion capture, robotics lab work, assembly, fine craft, or another hands-on technical environment.

  • Hands-on robot or glove-based data collection experience is a strong plus, but not a requirement. This kind of data collection is new, and we will teach you our specific tools and approach.

  • You build, not just run. Give you a vague request and a scrappy setup, and you can turn it into a clean, repeatable task with the right fixtures, environment, process, and written procedure.

  • You can operate autonomously. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex collection tasks with limited day-to-day support from engineering.

  • You understand quality beyond collection. You can review your work, recognize when collected data is unusable or below the quality bar, and understand why.

  • You are ready to lead. You have trained, mentored, or led others doing hands-on work and want to help establish the execution and quality standard for a growing team.

  • You work well with research and engineering teams. You can translate their requests into physical collection tasks and turn what you observe during collection into useful feedback.

  • You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice the moment something about the setup, hardware, environment, procedure, or collected data is off.

  • You are technically handy. You are comfortable with Linux, some Python scripting to automate repetitive work, and hardware assembly and troubleshooting.

  • You are comfortable in a fast-moving environment. Hardware, processes, and collection methods will evolve quickly, and you are comfortable adapting while helping improve how the team works.

  • You communicate well in English. You will work daily with teams in Paris and the Bay Area across time zones. French is a plus.

  • Bonus: reliability testing. You have partnered with a reliability or test team on real-robot testing.

Working conditions and role constraints

  • Work takes place in production environments and technical laboratories.

  • Prolonged standing and repetitive hand and arm movements while wearing collection equipment, including gloves, head-mounted cameras, and headsets, for extended periods.

  • Handling and lifting of loads, including props, fixtures, robot equipment, and station equipment, up to 23 kg for station setup and reconfiguration.

Why this role

  • Real ownership. You will have meaningful ownership over how the Paris data collection floor operates and help set the standard the team grows toward.

  • Hands-on leadership. You will remain close to the work while helping guide other operators, improve execution, and raise the quality bar.

  • Build, not just execute. You will take ambiguous collection needs and turn them into reliable, repeatable tasks that can scale across the team.

  • A clear growth path. As the operation scales, this role can grow toward leading or supervising teams of operators or toward broader project and program management responsibilities.

  • The front line of the mission. The data you create, review, and improve is what teaches our robots to work.

jobs.title: Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Technical Architect

Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customer’s broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

  • Define the work plan with customers on ongoing engagements, deciding together which AI use cases to build next and in what sequence.

  • Identify and/or support the next outcome opportunity within your accounts, and drive the additional services needed to deliver it — expanding the engagement as new use cases and workflows are identified.

  • Communicate status, risk, and progress to stakeholders at every level, manage escalations to resolution, and surface account risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner.

  • Feed the practice from the field, contributing the patterns, estimation inputs, and playbooks that make each AI deployment faster than the last.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of professional services experience in delivery management, engagement management, or technical program management, with significant time in front of enterprise customers delivering successful strategic outcomes

  • Experience in B2B SaaS scoping and delivering software implementation, transformation, or managed services engagements in complex enterprise environments, working in industry-standard work management, project management, or CRM platforms.

  • Commercial acumen sufficient to scope, price, and support the sale of services rather than simply deliver them, including effort estimation and statement of work authorship.

jobs.description:
Animateur réseaux magasins (H/F)

Le Groupe Cybertek est un acteur majeur dans le secteur de la vente de matériel informatique et High-Tech en France. Créé en 1996, son siège social et ses plateformes logistiques se trouvent à Bordeaux. Cybertek possède 28 magasins sous les enseignes Cybertek et Grosbill, ainsi que cinq sites de commerce en ligne. Employant 250 personnes, Cybertek a réussi à atteindre un chiffre d'affaires annuel de plus de 100 millions d'euros en s’appuyant sur des équipes dynamiques et soudées. Le Groupe Cybertek affirme son engagement en faveur de l’égalité professionnelle entre les femmes et les hommes et veille à promouvoir un environnement de travail inclusif, notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap.

Vos missions

Au cœur de nos magasins répartis sur toute la France lors de vos déplacements quotidiens, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans leur bon fonctionnement, l’accompagnement des équipes et le développement du chiffre d’affaires.

Réaliser le suivi des magasins définis :

  • Vérifier et contribuer à la mise en place d’une organisation permettant d’assurer le bon fonctionnement du point de vente (application et respect des procédures internes) ;

  • Veiller et participer à l’amélioration de l’image de marque du point de vente (présentation, ponctualité, propreté, accueil des clients, accueil téléphonique, rappel des clients, relationnel, etc.) ;

  • Contrôler les points de vente (stocks, activités réalisées au sein du point de vente, horaires d’ouverture) ;

  • Contrôler et analyser l’activité commerciale du magasin (devis, commandes, factures, chiffre d’affaires, résultats, objectifs) ;

  • Motiver, accompagner et soutenir les équipes ainsi que le Responsable dans le développement du chiffre d’affaires du point de vente ;

  • Assurer un soutien des équipes par une présence régulière dans chaque point de vente ;

  • Assurer les remplacements en magasin si nécessaires ;

  • Réaliser un entretien mensuel avec chaque Responsable afin d’évaluer l’avancement des objectifs, d’identifier les éventuelles difficultés et de prendre les décisions nécessaires en conséquence ;

Suivi des interventions et coordination avec la Direction :

  • Réaliser un rapport sur chaque passage et contrôle d’un point de vente

  • Analyser les données ;

  • Assurer un point régulier avec la Direction au cours d’entretiens ponctuels, par téléphone plusieurs fois par semaine ;

  • Organiser une réunion tous les quinze jours afin de réaliser un point détaillé sur chaque point de vente et de définir les futures interventions ;

  • Réaliser une réunion mensuelle avec la Direction afin de produire un bilan du mois écoulé et de définir les objectifs du mois suivant ;

  • Animer une réunion mensuelle avec les différents services du siège social du Groupe Cybertek en lien avec les magasins, afin d’identifier les difficultés rencontrées et d’améliorer la communication et la coordination entre les différents services (SAV, Technique, Stock, Administratif, etc.) ;

L’animation commerciale :

  • Animer les magasins et organiser les journées portes ouvertes (salons, partenariats, etc.) ;

  • Assurer le facing des magasins et veiller à la bonne présentation de l’offre produit et des produits en démonstration ;Assurer le suivi et le reporting des incentives et des différentes opérations commerciales.

Vos compétences

Vous justifiez d’une expérience dans le suivi et le contrôle de points de vente, idéalement dans le secteur de l’informatique ou de l’high-tech. Rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse des performances commerciales, le suivi des stocks et le contrôle du respect des procédures.

Vous savez accompagner et soutenir les équipes et les Responsables de magasin dans l’atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en identifiant les éventuels axes d’amélioration. Autonome, réactif(ve) et force de proposition, vous appréciez le travail de terrain, les déplacements et les échanges avec les différents services.

Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et contribuer activement à la performance et au bon fonctionnement de nos points de vente ? Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Contrôleur(se) Magasins !

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. This role is about composing cybersecurity-related agentic workflows focused on cyberdefense, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients — often in sovereign, on-premises or classified environments.

you will build some of the first AI-for-cyberdefense systems deployed in real government and defense environments, on frontier models you can influence. En tant qu’Account Executive / Account Manager Small Accounts, tu seras responsable du développement commercial d’un portefeuille de cabinets d’expertise comptable.

Ta priorité sera de développer l’acquisition de nouveaux cabinets, tout en augmentant progressivement la valeur des clients existants. Tu prendras en charge l’ensemble de la relation commerciale sur ton portefeuille régional : identification des opportunités, prospection, vente de Pennylane, accompagnement du déploiement et développement de revenus additionnels.

Tu seras responsable de ton portefeuille de bout en bout, en combinant acquisition et upsell afin de fluidifier l’expérience client, limiter les ruptures de suivi et maximiser la valeur générée dans la durée.

Tes responsabilités

  • Identifier et qualifier de nouveaux cabinets d’expertise comptable sur ton territoire.

  • Piloter l’ensemble du cycle de vente : prospection, découverte, qualification, démonstration, négociation, closing.

  • Faire remonter les retours clients et contribuer à l’amélioration des process, playbooks et messages commerciaux.

  • Organiser et participer à des événements locaux, webinaires et actions commerciales.

  • Analyser tes performances et développer continuellement ton efficacité commerciale.

Les critères de réussite

  • Atteinte régulière des objectifs d’acquisition et de développement de portefeuille.

  • Qualité des phases de découverte et de qualification.

  • Première expérience en vente B2B/Saas, account management ou développement commercial.

  • Goût du travail en équipe et de la collaboration transverse.

Geschäftsführerin / Geschäftsführer

Ein kerngesundes IT-Unternehmen erfolgreich in die Zukunft führen.

Unser Auftraggeber ist ein seit bald 40 Jahren erfolgreich etabliertes, inhabergeführtes und vollständig eigenfinanziertes Schweizer IT-Beratungs- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in der Nordwestschweiz und einer weiteren Geschäftsstelle. Als langjähriger, zertifizierter Partner einer führenden betriebswirtschaftlichen Standardsoftware realisiert das Team von rund 25 Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten integrierte ERP-Gesamtlösungen – von der Beratung und Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zu Support und Hosting. Ein heterogener, treuer Kundenstamm aus KMU, Grossbetrieben, öffentlicher Hand und sozialen Institutionen schätzt die hohe Qualität und Verlässlichkeit. Im Rahmen einer vorausschauenden– Regelung der Führungscrew - die beiden Gründer ziehen sich aus dem operativen Geschäft in den Verwaltungsrat zurück – suchen wir eine führungserfahrene, unternehmerisch geprägte Persönlichkeit.

Aufgaben

  • Operative Gesamtleitung und Steuerung des Unternehmens im Rahmen der strategischen Leitplanken des Verwaltungsrates, inkl. Vorbereitung der VR-Sitzungen.

  • Führung des Verkaufsleiters und Steuerung der Vertriebsaktivitäten mit Fokus auf Kundenbindung, Neukundengewinnung und Offertwesen.
  • Direkte Führung und Förderung der Bereiche Administration, Buchhaltung, Q-Leitung, Technik/Infrastruktur und Softwareentwicklung sowie Verantwortung für HR-Prozesse und Arbeitgeberpositionierung.
  • Sparringspartner der technischen Teams bei Lösungsentscheiden, IT-Security, Datenschutz (DSG) und internen Projekten.
  • Weiterentwicklung des Qualitätsmanagementsystems nach ISO 9001.
  • Steuerung von Vertragswesen, Versicherungsportfolio und Risikomanagement sowie Pflege der Partnerschaft mit dem zentralen Softwarelieferanten.
  • Pflege der Unternehmenskultur und Repräsentation des Unternehmens gegenüber Kunden, Partnern, Banken und Behörden.

Voraussetzungen

Sie verfügen über eine kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit betriebswirtschaftlicher Weiterbildung auf Stufe FH, HF oder Universität (z. B. Betriebsökonomie, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eidg. Diplom in Unternehmensführung). Sie bringen einen nachweisbaren Leistungsausweis in der Führung eines Schweizer KMU oder Dienstleistungsunternehmens mit – idealerweise in der IT-Branche – und bewegen sich sicher in Finanzen, Controlling und betriebswirtschaftlicher Steuerung. Eine ausgeprägte IT-Affinität setzen wir voraus; Erfahrung im ERP-Umfeld ist von Vorteil, spezifisches Produktwissen jedoch nicht erforderlich. Sie behalten das grosse Ganze im Blick, setzen klare Prioritäten und bringen einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch sowie ein ausgeprägtes Kostenbewusstsein mit. Mit Integrität, einem gesunden Mass an Bescheidenheit und natürlicher Autorität schaffen Sie Vertrauen und führen Mitarbeitende wertschätzend, situativ und auf Augenhöhe.

Attraktivität der Stelle

  • Gesamtleitung eines kerngesunden, vollständig eigenfinanzierten IT-Unternehmens mit solider Substanz.

jobs.title: Director of US Government Engagement
jobs.description:
Director of US Government Engagement

About the team

At Q-CTRL, the Government Engagement team works at the intersection of policy, international engagement, and national security to influence how governments govern and fund the development and adoption of quantum technologies. As trusted and respected leaders in the sector, we build enduring relationships with politicians, policymakers, and defense forces around the world to secure opportunities for Q-CTRL to deliver cutting-edge sovereign capability. We empower all areas of the business to understand and navigate government decision-making.

About the role
Reporting to the Global Head of Government Engagement, you’ll lead Q-CTRL’s US government engagement activities, working closely with our business development, technical, product, and marketing teams. You’ll shape policy and funding initiatives, build trusted relationships, and secure opportunities for Q-CTRL to partner commercially and strategically with government to deliver quantum computing and quantum sensing capabilities that advance US defense and economic interests.

What you'll be doing:

  • Develop and execute Q-CTRL’s US government engagement strategy, setting clear priorities for policy, legislative, and funding outcomes that support our growth and the adoption of quantum technologies.
  • Build and maintain trusted, bipartisan relationships with congressional offices and committees, the Department of War, federal agencies and state governments.
  • Serve as a trusted representative of company interests in political and policy forums, including engagements supporting business development with the USG.
  • Shape policy, legislation, and funding decisions through targeted advocacy, including developing proposals for authorization and appropriations processes and building support among key decision-makers.
  • Work closely with business development and technical colleagues to identify, assess, and secure government funding and partnership opportunities, connecting Q-CTRL’s capabilities with government priorities and mission needs.
  • Monitor and anticipate policy, legislative, budget, and regulatory developments, translating them into timely advice and recommended actions for company leadership.
  • Represent Q-CTRL in industry associations, think tanks, and policy forums, building coalitions that advance shared priorities and establish Q-CTRL as a trusted voice on quantum technology.
  • Other duties within the Employee's skills and experience, or with reasonable training.

Ideally you'll have:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in government, congressional affairs, public policy, or government relations, for example as a congressional staffer, government official, military officer, or lobbyist.
  • A demonstrated track record of shaping government decisions, with tangible achievements in policy development, legislation, or public funding.
  • A strong understanding of US federal policymaking and the legislative, authorization, appropriations, and agency budget processes, including when and how to engage effectively.
  • An established network across Capitol Hill, the executive branch, key federal departments, and the ability to build trusted relationships across political affiliations and institutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, persuasive arguments tailored to government audiences.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work across business functions to raise Q-CTRL’s profile and secure commercial opportunities.

It would be fantastic if you have these skills/experience but not essential:

  • Experience working with the Department of War and congressional defense committees, including familiarity with defense budgets, acquisition pathways, and the transition of emerging technologies into operational use.
  • Experience working in a technology startup or scaleup, particularly in a role connecting government engagement with commercial growth.
  • Experience in the advanced technology, defense, or aerospace sectors.
  • Experience shaping policy or funding for quantum or other critical technologies, such as AI, semiconductors, space, or advanced sensing.
  • Experience with state government engagement, economic development initiatives, and allied technology cooperation through frameworks such as AUKUS.

Compensation

Additional Information

We take a multidisciplinary approach to quantum computing research, bringing together experts from diverse fields. We particularly value versatile and self-motivated problem solvers. If you are passionate about making quantum computers useful, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet all of the requirements listed above.

Salary

The targeted base salary range for this position is between $210,000 - $260,000 and will ultimately be determined by specific job-related skills, experience, level, location and other contributing factors. This role will be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and the opportunity to equity and other forms of compensation outside of the targeted base salary range.

This position is eligible for Q-CTRL's U.S. health insurance benefits, subject to plan eligibility requirements, as well as HSA, FSA, PTO, Company paid parental leave, 401k with an employer match, and a Learning, Development and Wellness allowance. For more information on benefits at Q-CTRL, please visit our careers page at https://q-ctrl.com/careers.

Should you have any questions related to the compensation package, please speak directly with the Talent Acquisition representative.

About Q-CTRL
Q-CTRL is the global leader in AI-powered quantum control infrastructure software. We build the tools that make quantum technology useful, solving the hardest challenges in quantum computing and quantum sensing to deliver real-world impact. We’ve shown that the same enabling software which we’ve used to deliver GPS-free quantum navigation on real aircraft and drones is also able to stabilize quantum computers against errors and deliver true quantum advantage. This view makes Q-CTRL diversified index-fund bet on the entire quantum ecosystem, illustrated by the breadth of our customer engagements, from Airbus to IBM, Lockheed Martin and the Department of War to Softbank.

We work quickly to turn cutting-edge science into deployable technology. With this approach we’ve delivered the holy grail in quantum – quantum advantage – in two different domains within a year and brought commercial offerings to market on an accelerated timescale. Our teams bring together technical and multi-disciplinary expertise across the product lifecycle, and we’re hiring talent to help scale every part of the business.

Founded in 2017, we operate globally with offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Huntsville, Sydney, Berlin and Oxford. Q-CTRL has raised over US$420M, including our record setting $290M Series C fundraise in 2026, placing us as one of the best capitalized and most successful private businesses in the quantum sector. We’re looking for dedicated and ambitious staff to grow our team as we prepare for the next stage of our growth into a generational business.

At Q-CTRL, we prioritize outcomes over hours. We offer flexibility, equity potential, and competitive benefits that reflect our high-performance culture. If you’re ready to help shape the future of quantum, we’d love to hear from you.

Please be advised that our communications will only come from the @q-ctrl.com domain. All our active job postings are available on our company website.

To recruitment agencies, we do not accept unsolicited branded profiles and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. Cloudbeds is looking for a Senior Customer Support & Onboarding Specialist - Accounting to own our most complex customer accounting work. This role sits at the intersection of hospitality operations, accounting, and technology, guiding properties through the end-to-end accounting flow, from property configuration to integration with their accounting software or ERP.

As the senior member of the team, you'll take on the hardest implementations and escalations, including multi-property and enterprise customers, be the go-to expert for Support, Onboarding and Account Management on anything accounting, and help shape how we onboard and support customers' financial setups as we scale.   • Mittendrin statt nur dabei – Du unterstützt das Team im Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst laufend neue Aufgaben – kein Tag ist wie der andere.

Qualifikation

Must-haves:

jobs.title: Backend Engineer | 36labs
jobs.description:
Backend Engineer | 36labs

Role: Backend Engineer

Company: 36 Labs

Location: London, Baker Street office, four days a week (a move to Primrose Hill is likely within a couple of months). London-based candidates only. No relocation and no visa sponsorship in this hiring cycle.

Job Type: Full-time

About 36 Labs

36 Labs is an applied AI research firm in London. It works on a problem most models are still bad at: making creative decisions, and explaining why they were made. The team wants models to reason creatively, more like a person would.

Today the product is a harness that sits over any frontier model, video generation models in particular. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

You'll be a key player in the Connect domain, one of the fastest-growing channels at Mollie. Your direct contribution ensures we maximize the value of our strategic partnerships, translating product potential into significant revenue growth across Europe. This is a chance to move fast and own the outcome of a critical expansion vector.

You will manage a dedicated portfolio of SaaS accounts, responsible for driving their complete lifecycle. Your focus won't just be retention; it's on market expansion and aggressive revenue growth. You'll work cross-functionally—collaborating with teams across Mollie to drive growth for our partners and increase adoption of key products like Mollie Capital, in-person payments, and more—ensuring these accounts thrive and contribute to Mollie’s overall success.

  • Drive new in-year net revenue from your portfolio of accounts, exceeding aggressive growth targets for the Connect channel.

Executive Director, Clinical Development

“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Executive Director, Clinical Development

Team / Culture Leadership

  • Mentor internal team members and external consultants/CRO partners.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, urgency, and quality.
  • Operate effectively in a lean biotech environment where flexibility and ownership are essential.

Experience and Qualifications:
